result.requirement: The system shall automatically monitor Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance for delivery times and order accuracy regarding Store Partners and alert the Fulfillment Supervisor upon breach.
result.business_need: The business needs to proactively identify performance gaps to maintain contractual obligations and ensure customer satisfaction with delivery reliability.
functional_behaviour: The system shall calculate the actual elapsed time between the Order Request creation and the Delivery Proof submission for each Delivery Assignment.
The system shall compare the actual elapsed time against the time window defined in the Store Partner Agreement to determine if a delivery time breach has occurred.
The system shall verify the accuracy of the Order Request against the Delivery Proof to identify any discrepancies in item quantities or special handling notes.
The system shall generate a Dispute Ticket and notify the Fulfillment Supervisor when a breach is detected.
The system shall record the breach details in a Feedback Record for future performance analysis.
related_information_requirements: The specific time window for order preparation and dispatch defined in the contract.
The verified details of items selected by the customer and their quantities.
The timestamp confirming the formal transfer of possession to a delivery agent.
The calculated estimates of travel duration and distance for the specific route.
business_rules: A delivery time breach occurs if the time between Order Request creation and Delivery Proof submission exceeds the agreed time window.
An order accuracy breach occurs if the items in the Delivery Proof do not match the Order Request specifications.
A breach notification must be generated immediately upon detection of any SLA violation.
The system must exclude force majeure events defined in the Store Partner Agreement from breach calculations.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Assignment is created with a 2-hour preparation window in the Store Partner Agreement.
acceptance_criteria.when: The Delivery Proof is submitted 2 hours and 15 minutes after the Order Request creation.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall flag a delivery time breach and notify the Fulfillment Supervisor.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Delivery Assignment is created with a 2-hour preparation window in the Store Partner Agreement.
acceptance_criteria.when: The Delivery Proof is submitted within 2 hours but contains an extra item not in the Order Request.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system shall flag an order accuracy breach and notify the Fulfillment Supervisor.
